snippet.title: Guitar Fretter 2 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Features a live playthrough of 3 levels of Guitar Fretter 2.

Guitar Fretter is an action puzzle game and playful practice tool for guitarists of all kinds.  Now available for phones, tablets, and desktops: 

Apple App Store:
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/guitar-fretter/id382970995?mt=8

Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.stenzingersoftware.games.guitarfretter&hl=en_US

itch.io for Windows and MacOS:
https://robstenzinger.itch.io/guitar-fretter
